image_description: A close-up, slightly low-angle shot of a vintage audio cassette tape. The casing is a translucent olive-green plastic. A yellow paper label with handwritten red text is affixed to the top. The two circular spool hubs are visible, appearing empty or with very little tape. The central rectangular window for the tape path is black/empty. There are molded details on the bottom edge including small rectangular slots and screw holes. The image has a grainy, noisy texture typical of older digital photography or film scan.
